title: Install OS filesystem confinement on capable reviewed GREG workers
problem: Actual CI provides an unprivileged kernel confinement facility despite the disconnected local host's unsupported probes; do not freeze this buildable dependency.
baseline: PR1471a376f68 native company regression checks passed; full suite/verifier still pending. CI6324 observed Linux6.17.0-1022-azure, Landlock ABI7 and Docker28.0.4; its one remaining authority-inventory failure is preserved.

alternatives.name: simplest_viable_alternative
alternatives.description: Add kernel-enforced stage/source/runtime filesystem rules to existing reviewed workers on ABI>=3 hosts; selected.
advantages: Strengthens real native filesystem enforcement without a new authority or source grant.
disadvantages: Not microVM/gVisor isolation and not arbitrary-source admission.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Changed ABI, runtime or confinement evidence.

alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
alternatives.description: OCI plus microVM/gVisor backend for general generated code/providers.
advantages: Broader demanded capability and group isolation.
disadvantages: Requires an implemented pinned runner/image and its actual escape/revocation/resource tests; ordinary Docker or observed availability alone is insufficient.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Built and proved runner/image on the available CI host.

alternatives.name: reversible_experiment
alternatives.description: Raw native private-file escape probes and actual GREG/child/MCP integration under required Landlock in CI.
advantages: Proves OS denial independent of audit hooks on an actual host.
disadvantages: Does not establish general code safety or founder operational acceptance.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Changed implementation and deeper adversarial evidence.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Ignore usable ABI7 and retain unnecessarily weak reviewed-code-only filesystem protection.
disadvantages: Repeats the false project-wide blocker/local increment stopping failure.

roles.position: Measure actual CI host. ABI7 and Docker28.0.4 were observed at6324, while local Codex runtime remains disconnected. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: A local-host failure could be treated as a global technology blocker.

roles.position: Require ABI>=3 and complete kernel rule/restriction installation; any supported-host installation error fails the worker. Unavailable reviewed hosts retain explicitly labelled Python protection; source remains refused. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Partial Landlock installation or unsupported ABI could be reported as OS confinement.

roles.position: Explicit published files, interpreter-owned runtime paths and loaded ELF inputs; stage-only writes; raw libc open, write, truncate and symlink escape probes without audit hooks. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Library/source rules could expose private files, permit writes outside stage, or miss native reads.

roles.position: Test inherited DSL/packaging confinement and first-party MCP with real SDK; test actual GREG staged persistence and all existing runtime suites. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Confinement could break exact child recipes, packaging or MCP instead of advancing the machine.

roles.position: Keep source/provider refusal, network-denied workers, budgets/revocation/staging and system10 full acceptance. Landlock filesystem protection does not retire generic execution, microVM/gVisor or group-isolation obligations. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: An OS filesystem proof could be mistaken for microVM completion or authorization of arbitrary code.
